basic_info.description: Experience sophisticated urban living in this meticulously renovated condominium in Telegraph Hill. Featuring high-end finishes throughout, Residence 207 boasts an expanded kitchen with custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, Fisher Paykel & Liebherr appliances, and Rohl plumbing fixtures. Solid white oak floors arranged in an elegant herringbone pattern flow throughout the home, alongside new interior doors and closets, new electrical systems, re-textured walls, and bespoke spa-like bath. Every detail has been considered in this thoughtful renovation. Enjoy serene bay views from the living space in this prime location, just steps to the heart of vibrant North Beach, Jackson Square, and the Financial District. Deeded, independent garage parking, storage, and in-unit washer/dryer hook-ups complete the home, along with two shared entertaining decks featuring panoramic views of the Bay Bridge and city skyline, barbeque, community room with Peloton, and guest parking with EV charging. This modern retreat combines timeless craftsmanship with urban convenience, making it a perfect sanctuary in the heart of San Francisco.
